# Code Dock

> Public documentation for Code Dock, an independent hosted service providing temporary international phone numbers for one SMS verification code per order. Repository documentation and the read-only information tool are free; the hosted service is paid.

Facts checked: 2026-10-14. Source: the operator's public website configuration and terms. Current purchase-page terms, prices and inventory take precedence over this dated summary.

- Default plan: CNY 9.90 per order, OpenAI / ChatGPT with automatic country selection.
- Custom plan: CNY 19.90 per order, service or country selection from current options.
- Each order covers one SMS verification code.
- Claim links expire 24 hours after creation; this is not 24-hour number rental.
- Up to 10 replacements, at least 120 seconds apart, after confirmation that the previous number received no code.
- Service and country selection are fixed after order creation. Inventory queries do not reserve numbers.
- Codes do not guarantee third-party number acceptance or successful verification. Number freshness is not guaranteed.
- No change-of-mind refund after successful delivery; duplicate charges and undelivered orders are reviewed by support.
- Payment is verified before claim delivery. Telegram notifications apply only to orders associated with the bot purchase entry.
- Code Dock has no official affiliation with the named third-party platforms.
- This repository does not contain the hosted backend, a procurement SDK, or customer credentials.

## Public service entry points

- [Website](https://119-28-110-73.sslip.io/): service information.
- [Purchase page](https://119-28-110-73.sslip.io/shop): current plans and options.
- [Telegram bot](https://t.me/Code_readingBot): service entry and associated-order delivery.
- [Support](https://t.me/Whaocau): private order assistance.
